complexity.time: O(N) full table scan or O(K) with composite index
complexity.notes: Predicate filtering on two categorical columns.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full dataset scanning without indexes causes unnecessary I/O on large inventories.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A bitmap or composite index on (low_fats, recyclable) yields instant point lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should craft the straightforward filter accurately.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def find_products(products: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = products[(products["low_fats"] == "Y") & (products["recyclable"] == "Y")]
    return df[["product_id"]]
